notes.title: Bandai Namco would like you to have a free dog
notes.notes:
Today I learned that ‘Wanko’ is Japanese for dog, rather than just being Aussie slang in the vein of ‘smoko’ or my favourite, 'bottle-o', which is what they call an off-license. I learnt this because of Doronko Wanko, a lovely free game about a dirty pomeranian where you try to score as high as possible by doing actual, financial damage to your owner’s home.

notes.title: "DORONKO WANKO" Launch - We Look Forward to Your Feedback
notes.notes:
🐶Make a mess all over the house! DORONKO WANKO!🐶
"DORONKO WANKO"
Released on March 26th at 5:00 PM!

"DORONKO WANKO" is a muddy action game where Pomeranians messily dirty up beautiful homes. Run around freely, make a mess, and get every room covered in mud!

【Request from DORONKO WANKO】
This game was developed as part of Bandai Namco Studio's rookie training program.

We greatly appreciate everyone playing the game and providing feedback, as it serves as encouragement for our rookie creators. We look forward to hearing your thoughts on X(Twitter), Steam reviews/community, and more.

---
【Regarding Gameplay/Streaming】
Thank you for playing "DORONKO WANKO".
We allow gameplay and streaming for both personal and commercial purposes, aiming for everyone to enjoy the game casually and joyfully. Please refer to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2512840/view/4131562530397459824?l=english]these guidelines[/url] and have fun with the game.

Additionally, you can use fan kits such as images from [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q6zeDlF1YOyvgcmWOHFpLmoqGife2Bql?usp=sharing]here[/url].

Please continue to enjoy "DORONKO WANKO" in the future!
